captions.detailed: A vent-and-slide sunroof cassette assembly consisting of a large, flat rectangular frame in a matte black finish. It features dual parallel guide rails running lengthwise, within which a secondary sliding carriage can travel. A semi-transparent grey glass sunroof panel is mounted to this carriage, supported by a front hinge mechanism that allows it to tilt upward for venting, as well as slide back along the rails to open.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated vent-and-slide sunroof cassette model. The assembly should feature a wide rectangular black base frame with parallel guide tracks, a sliding carriage that translates along these tracks, and a semi-transparent grey glass panel that tilts upward via a front hinge relative to the carriage.
captions.factory: The code constructs a base frame using a flat rectangular box, subtracting a central opening and adding two parallel rectangular slots to act as guide rails. The sliding carriage is modeled as a cross-bar with side guide blocks that fit into the rails. The sunroof glass is constructed from a thin, wide box with a hollowed center for the semi-transparent pane, connected to the carriage via a front revolute joint (hinge) and to the base via a prismatic joint that allows translation along the rails.
